title: A mass-type invariant for smooth metric measure spaces and its relation with the fractional Yamabe problem
summary: On asymptotically Schwarzschild smooth metric measure spaces modeled on the Euclidean half-space, we define a new mass-type invariant analogous to the ADM mass of an asymptotically flat manifold. We prove that this invariant is independent of the choice of admissible asymptotic coordinates. We further show that it fits into a very general framework for mass-type invariants and we also isolate static equations for smooth metric measure spaces under natural boundary conditions.
